mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (follower_id, followee_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE followee_id = #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId})
mapper.sql: SELECT f.id AS follow_id, f.created_at AS followed_at, u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.icon_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows mf WHERE mf.follower_id = #{me} AND mf.followee_id = u.id) AS followed_by_me FROM follows f
